name: 06702 · Waterbury, CT
findings: ZIP 06702 (Waterbury) has 66 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06702 (Waterbury) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
